newsitem.title: USA: Texaco says hydrotreater, alkylation return.
newsitem.headline: Texaco says hydrotreater, alkylation return.

text.p: A hydrotreater and alkylation unit at Texaco Inc's Wilmington refinery near Los Angeles returned to service over the weekend after prolonged shutdowns due to fires, a company spokeswoman said.
Separate fires shut the 20,000 barrel-per-day (bpd) hydrotreater and 9,000 bpd alkylation unit at the plant, located south of Los Angeles.
"Our hydrotreater is up and running and so is our alkylation unit," the spokeswoman said Monday. "(They've) been up for the past couple days."
The plant's overall crude intake is 92,000 bpd.
The alkylation unit, which helps make gasoline, caught fire in mid-January and boosted wholesale gasoline prices 2.75 cents a gallon the day it shut.
The number four hydrotreater raised refined product prices about two cents when a fire damaged it last November.
